preconditions.description: root is an instance of TreeNode

postconditions.description: The root of the returned BST is an instance of TreeNode

postconditions.expression: all(root.val + sum(node.val for node in traverse_tree(root, 'greater')) == modified_node.val for modified_node, node in zip(traverse_tree(root, 'inorder'), traverse_tree(root, 'inorder')))
postconditions.description: Every node's value in the modified BST is the sum of its original value and the values of all nodes greater than it in the original BST
